questions.question: What type of unemployment will be generated by the agricultural sector in case when it employs additional labourers only for some time of the year like the harvest season?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Seasonal unemployment.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The scenario described in the question is a classic example of** seasonal unemployment.**
 
• It occurs when there is a predictable pattern of **employment and unemployment** in a particular sector or industry due to **seasonal changes or fluctuations** in demand.
 
• Agricultural sector is one of the most common industries where **seasonal unemployment occurs.**
 
• It is also known as** agricultural unemployment**, where farmers and other agricultural workers are employed only during the specific seasons like **harvesting, sowing, plowing, etc.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Disguised unemployment **is a situation where more people are employed in a job than actually required.

 
 
• It is often seen in the agricultural sector where a large number of people work on a small piece of land, leading to **low productivity and low wages.**
 
 
 
• **Cyclical unemployment** occurs due to the fluctuations in the business cycle.
 
 
• It is caused by changes in the economic conditions, such as** recession, depression, or boom.**
 
 
 
• **Structural unemployment **occurs due to the changes in the structure of the economy.
 
 
• It happens when there is a mismatch between the **skills of the workers and the requirements of the jobs. **

questions.question: A ________ is a deposit account opted for by many who wish to save a certain part of their earnings.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**savings account.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **savings account** is a **deposit account** that allows individuals to **save a certain part of their earnings.**
 
• It is a type of account offered by **banks and financial institutions** that pays interest on the **deposited amount.**
 
• The interest rate may vary depending on the **bank and the balance** in the account.
 
• A savings account provides easy **accessibility to funds,** and individuals can **withdraw money** whenever they need it without any penalty.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Share, loan, and debenture are **not deposit** accounts.
 
• Shares represent** ownership in a company,** a loan is** borrowed money **that needs to be repaid with interest, and debentures are a** type of bond** that companies issue to raise capital.

questions.question: Export of goods enhances ________.

__
 
• **Export of goods **brings** foreign exchange** into the country, which **strengthens the economy.**
 
• Exporting goods increases the demand for **domestically produced goods, **leading to higher production and employment levels.
 
• Exporting goods enhances the **country's reputation** in the global market, which attracts** foreign investment **and promotes **economic growth.**
 
• Exporting goods helps to** diversify the economy, **reducing dependence on a** particular sector or market.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Expenses** may lead to **lower expenses** as production levels increase due to **higher demand.**
 
• **Local debt and nation's loan** are **not **related to exporting goods, but are more dependent on factors like **government policies, fiscal management, and economic conditions.**

questions.question: The State Government under Consumer Protection Act 2019, by notification, shall establish a ________, in each district of the State.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per the **Consumer Protection Act 2019**, each district of the state shall have a **District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission** established by the State Government.
 
• The main objective of this commission is to provide** speedy and efficient resolution** of consumer disputes at the** district level.**
 
• The commission has the power to **summon witnesses, receive evidence, **and make necessary orders to resolve the disputes.
 
• The commission can also impose penalties on erring parties and **order compensation **to consumers who have suffered losses due to unfair practices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission** is an appellate body that hears appeals against the orders passed by the** State and District Commissions.**

questions.question: Why did Mohammed Ali Jinnah, Madan Mohan Malaviya and Mazhar Ul Haq resign from the Imperial Legislative Council?

options.text: to protest against the Rowlatt Act
to protest against the Simon commission

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**to protest against the Rowlatt Act.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mohammed Ali Jinnah, Madan Mohan Malaviya and Mazhar Ul Haq **resigned from the** Imperial Legislative Council **to protest against the **Rowlatt Act**, which was introduced in **1919** by the British government in India.
 
• The Rowlatt Act gave the British government enormous powers to** suppress political dissent **and **curtail civil liberties**.
 
• It allowed the government to arrest and imprison anyone without **trial for up to two years.**
 
• Jinnah, Malaviya and Haq saw the Rowlatt Act as a threat to the **rights and freedoms of Indian citizens **and believed that it violated the principles of justice and democracy.
 
• By resigning from the** Imperial Legislative Council**, they wanted to show their opposition to the **Act and raise awareness **about its negative impact on Indian society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Simon commission,** on the other hand, was appointed in **1927 **by the British government to review the working of the** Indian constitution** and **recommend changes.**
 
• **Jinnah and Malaviya **were both members of the commission, but they** resigned** from it later due to their differences with the government over the issue of Indian independence.

questions.question: Foods with starch in them will turn blue-black when they come in contact with ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**iodine.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Iodine **is a** chemical element **that is used as an indicator to test for the** presence of starch** in food.
 
• When iodine comes in contact with starch, it forms a** blue-black complex **that is visible to the naked eye.
 
• This reaction is due to the formation of an **amylose-iodine complex,** which is a type of chemical bond between iodine and starch.
 
• Salt, blue litmus, and red litmus are** not** indicators of starch and do not react with it in any way.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Iodine **is a **halogen element t**hat is commonly used as an **antiseptic, disinfectant, and nutritional supplement.**
 
• It is also used in the production of **dyes, photographic film, **and other industrial applications.
 
• **Blue litmus** is an indicator that is used to test for the** presence of acids** in a solution.
 
 
• It turns **red in the presence of acids** and remains blue in the presence of bases or neutral solutions.
 
 
 
• **Red litmus **is an indicator that is used to test for the **presence of bases** in a solution.
 
 
• It turns **blue in the presence of bases** and remains red in the presence of acids or neutral solutions.

questions.question: Kati Bihu, one of the three Bihu festivals of Assam, is celebrated in the month of ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**October.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kati Bihu** is one of the **three Bihu festivals** celebrated in **Assam, India.**
 
• This festival is celebrated in the **month of October,** which is also known as** Kati month **in the **Assamese calendar.**
 
• Kati Bihu is also known as **Kangali Bihu **or the festival of the poor, as it falls in the month when **farmers face scarcity of food **and are dependent on the next harvest.
 
• During Kati Bihu, **people light lamps** and offer prayers to **Goddess Lakshmi **to seek her blessings for a good harvest.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other festivals celebrated in Assam are** Baishagu, Ali-Ai-Ligang, Baikho, Rongker, Rajini Gabra Harni Gabra, Bohaggiyo Bishu, Ambubashi Mela and Jonbill Mela.**

questions.question: What are the volcanoes which have not erupted for a very long time but might erupt in future called?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Dormant volcanoes.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dormant volcanoes** are those which have not erupted** **for a long time but are **still considered capable** of erupting in the future.
 
• These volcanoes may show signs of activity such as** earthquakes, gas emissions or ground deformation.**
 
• The length of time a volcano has been dormant does not necessarily determine its** likelihood of erupting,** as some volcanoes can remain dormant for centuries before erupting again.
 
• It is important to **monitor dormant volcanoes** to ensure that communities living near them are prepared for potential eruptions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Extinct volcanoes** are those that are **not expected to erupt again.**
 
• **Active volcanoes **are those that are currently **erupting or have erupted** recently.
 
• **Shield volcanoes **are a type of volcano characterized by their **broad, gently sloping cone shape.**

questions.question: Sri Lanka is separated from India by the ________.

questions.question: Which two gases are released when lead nitrate is heated?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Nitrogen dioxide and oxygen.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lead nitrate** when heated undergoes** decomposition reaction** and releases **two gases.**
 
• The two gases released are** nitrogen dioxide (NO₂) and oxygen (O₂).**
 
• Nitrogen dioxide is a **reddish-brown toxic gas** with a pungent odor and is a major air pollutant.
 
• It contributes to the formation of** acid rain and respiratory problems.**
 
• Oxygen is a** colorless, odorless gas** that is essential for respiration and combustion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lead nitrate** is a **white crystalline solid** that is soluble in water and is used in the manufacture of **explosives, matches, and other chemicals.**
 
• **Nitrogen oxide** (NOx) is a group of highly reactive gases that are formed when fuel is burned at** high temperatures.**
 
 
• They contribute to the formation of **smog and acid rain.**
 
 
 
• **Carbon monoxide **(CO) is a** colorless, odorless gas **that is produced by incomplete **combustion of fossil fuels**.
 
 
• It is toxic and can cause **headaches, dizziness**, and even death in high concentrations.
